proposed_capability: P95 -> P82 -> P08 -> P07 -> P124: fund active Sims 4 household using exact EA money first and one explicitly authorized, externally verified additive fallback when exact money is observed ineffective; independent of launcher and install directory.
player_save_control_impact: Host lab-only opt-in dispatch; never modify saves, peripheral services, key mappings, accessibility settings, game mode, portrait, launcher registration or arbitrary game files; never impersonate native in-game autonomy.

architectural_assessment.P95: Maintain existing canonical planner and host adapter; treat Steam, EA app, Epic and trial/base edition as storefront/profile metadata rather than different cheat engines or assumed paths. Attach to explicitly selected running Sims PID; no directory scanning.
architectural_assessment.P82: Falsify unknown/stale funds, unconfirmed earlier dispatch, delayed money effect, richer target, non-multiple-of-1000 remainder, command tampering, false PID, player takeover, unsupported OS/patch and unsupported storefront.
architectural_assessment.P08: Local Windows disposable save is not available remotely: exact executable basename, active session, console open/focus, before/after HUD evidence, fallback single-effect trials and cancellation must be tested in a real game.
architectural_assessment.P07: Add recovery planner, CLI and contract/tests with consultation pre-commit. Only proceed to integration after provider checks; do not fabricate local pass.
architectural_assessment.P124: Do not create a second UI controller, global watchers, game locator, path-crawling subsystem, or unconditional motherlode loops. Reuse screen lease and command validation.

selected_recovery_strategy.primary: testingcheats true; money <target> (EA documented exact balance).
selected_recovery_strategy.fallback: After a previous command has been DISPATCHED and a fresh, distinct HUD evidence reference shows no change, require explicit --confirmed-noop plus --prior-dispatch-ref. Choose ONE non-overshooting EA-documented motherlode (+50000) or kaching (+1000) command. Never chain, auto repeat or guess exact when remainder <1000.
selected_recovery_strategy.exit: Require new HUD before next attempt. If not divisible by 1000, route to exact-command/manual diagnosis rather than overshoot or hidden save edits.
selected_recovery_strategy.execution_admission: Existing ACTIVE session, exact PID, human-first screen lease, allowed game mode, foreground process basename TS4_x64.exe or TS4.exe and fresh probes; abort on unknown. No game discovery or control across apps.
selected_recovery_strategy.compatibility: Any verified Windows Sims 4 executable directory and storefront can be supplied via existing explicit PID flow; Mac, consoles, trial binaries and untested patches remain unverified rather than falsely claimed universal.
